jobs.prompt: Fix these Opus review findings in tools/gate-rerun.mjs and extend tests/gate-rerun.test.mjs (existing module, not wired). HIGH 1: test ids from pytest output are passed as raw arguments; only parse the 'short test summary info' section, match lines from column 0, accept only ids matching ^[\w./-]+\.py(::\S.*)?$ with no leading '-', no '..' segment and not absolute, and put '--' before the ids in the rerun argv. HIGH 2: for node:test the file named in a location or 'test at' line becomes an argument unchecked: reject a leading '-', require a relative path that stays inside cwd (path.resolve check) and that looks like a test file. HIGH 3: the node argv rebuild is wrong: for ['node','--import','./tests/_isolate-config.mjs','--test','{affected}'] it drops the value of --import, runs the setup file as a test and passes the literal {affected}; skip the value after flags that take one (--import, --require, -r, --loader, --test-reporter, --test-reporter-destination, --test-concurrency=N style stays single) and drop {affected} and other placeholder arguments; assert the exact resulting argv in the test. Also MED 7 (escapeRegExp must escape '*' and every regex metacharacter; --test-name-pattern values anchored ^...$). Add tests for: ids or files starting with '-', containing '..', absolute; exact node argv for ['node','--import','./tests/_isolate-config.mjs','--test','{affected}']; a regex metacharacter in a test name. Do not change redaction or kill handling in this job. IMPORTANT: the repository's secret scanner blocks test files with literal secret-looking assignments: in tests build fake secret values at run time (concatenation or repeat) and use neutral variable names. Keep every existing test passing unless it asserts the buggy behaviour described here (then fix that assertion).
